# Company-brain schema and fictional sample

The bundled `company-brain` schema and sample Markdown derive from
[mattzimak/gbrain-company-brain](https://github.com/mattzimak/gbrain-company-brain),
revision `d2c8beec4f55350f98af63708a947ac374378286`, licensed under MIT.
The complete upstream license is included in this directory.

GBrain's adaptation separates the inherited company and product types, preserves
non-destructive mapping rules, and uses generic fictional names in the sample.
Schema version `0.2.0` identifies this adaptation, not an upstream release.
Installing GBrain does not activate this optional schema or any upstream skills.
